Name: Quick Load
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default this mod simply lets you reload the last last loaded game from the title menu by pressing a hotkey. Before using it for the first time, you have to load into a game to let it know which save to use.

The config.json file created when you first run the game with this mod installed contains the following options:


[code]﻿{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "Hotkey": "F7",
  "SaveFolder": "Pokey_268323667",
  "UseLastLoaded": true,
}
[/code]

[b]SaveFolder[/b] is set automatically, no need to change that.

If [b]UseLastLoaded[/b] is set to [b]false[/b] the mod will only switch saves when you save, not when you load a save.



[size=5][b]Technical:[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
